metadata.methods_description: EEG data were acquired at 256 Hz sampling rate from 16 channels using a g.USBamp (g.tec) amplifier with standard 10-20 electrode montage. The experimental paradigm employed a 6x6 checkerboard visual stimulus presentation with target and non-target event classifications. Each subject completed one session with a trial interval of 0-1.0 seconds. Data were processed using HED 8.4.0 event annotations and feature extraction based on P300 ERP detection.
